mainText: Top five Liverpool-Man City moments. Relive five classic moments between Liverpool and Manchester City before Sunday's Premier League game at Anfield (16:30 BST). What reception awaits Man City at Anfield?. Bus welcomes, banners and flags expected as Man City head to Liverpool on Sunday for their first game since they were found guilty of breaching Premier League rules. Henderson scores twice as five-star Chelsea thrash Bournemouth. Jordan Henderson has a home debut to remember as he scores twice for Chelsea as his side thrash Bournemouth 5-1 at Stamford Bridge, leaving the away side still searching for their first Premier League win this season.

mainText: Riyadh airport attack another dangerous moment in already tense conflict. The Houthis have stepped up their attacks on Saudi Arabian soil, and while the physical damage can be quickly repaired, its reputation for stability is taking a battering. Buildings swept away as flash floods hit central Nepal. A flash flood at the Budhi Gandaki River has swept away several buildings and bridges, two months after catastrophic floods hit the country. Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack. A wildlife park is closed after a man entered the tiger enclosure and was fatally attacked. UK does not support Trump's Russia diesel deal, says Streeting. The defence secretary says the US and its allies need to increase pressure on Vladimir Putin to end the war with Ukraine.
